algorithm_mapping.upstream: linesweeper topology.rs60-143 BinaryWindingNumber and tagged addition; 710-808 process_sweep_line_range
algorithm_mapping.adaptation: Exact west-to-east ordered original vertical identities accumulate two independent signed winding counters. Endpoint inequalities encode formal sides of an atomic interval, avoiding midpoint rounding and epsilon movement. Horizontal north/south events use separate enter/exit predicates.

algorithm_mapping.upstream: linesweeper curve/line.rs exact straight-line interaction; segments.rs280-345 closed LineTo insertion
algorithm_mapping.adaptation: Strict finite axis lines only; exact perpendicular coordinate selection and collinear overlap endpoints. Keep eight source identities, split only output intervals. Curves, auto-closure and further subdivisions refused.

algorithm_mapping.local: side_windings plus exact duplicate boundary interval suppression in evaluate
algorithm_mapping.adaptation: Combine all source winding contributions for each exact coincident interval before boundary visibility. Exact equality replaces epsilon proximity. No deleted coincident payload remains in output.

algorithm_mapping.upstream: linesweeper topology.rs1287-1424 contours_for_positions boundary predicate and incident-halfedge walk
algorithm_mapping.adaptation: Walk visible directed halfedges around each endpoint by clockwise angular order from the reverse halfedge. Every boundary segment visited once. Inline visited/ref arrays replace dynamic paths.

algorithm_mapping.upstream: linesweeper topology.rs1340-1359 scan-west contour parent selection
algorithm_mapping.local: contains_loop and westmost containing-outer selection in contours
algorithm_mapping.adaptation: Exact original-coordinate west scan gives enclosing outer for each hole, bounded iterative traversal. Two rectangles cannot produce multiply nested holes; unexpected non-simple turn count or missing parent refuses.

allocation_contract.storage: Fixed inline scratch and Network value; borrowed style identity. No Vec, Box, Arc, String, hash tree, SmallVec growth or sorting scratch in provider. Caller allocating an ownership wrapper must reserve its actual layout separately before allocation. Caller input/attribution storage remains caller-owned and pre-admitted.
allocation_contract.retirement: Provider returns an inline owned immutable Network; borrowed style lifetime is explicit. No private provider ledger, lease or retained heap cache.

bound_derivation: Each of 8 edges owns 2 endpoints plus at most 2 points from each of 7 partners:16 unique references. Adjacent references yield at most15 nonzero intervals, total120.
At most8 original rectangle vertices plus2 points per28 unordered pairs gives64 candidate vertices. Output deduplicates coordinates before insertion.
Atomic interval start/end actions total at most240, counted as two admitted sweep events per nonzero source interval, including later invisible/coincident intervals.
Intersections counts admitted exact pair contact points, including collinear overlap endpoints and shared original endpoints, per unordered source-edge pair; at most56.
Each visible deduplicated boundary segment belongs to one directed loop. The shared loop reference arena is120 total, not120 per loop. Every insert has a capacity guard and caller output limit check.
eliminated_reviewed_states: TreeVec/Box root and split or iterator stack
EventQueue BTreeSet and repeated dynamic intersection scheduling
CurveOrder SmallVec/Metrics Vec/cubic recursion and numerical root solvers

precision: No midpoint, arithmetic-generated intersection coordinate, epsilon displacement, approximate refit, sliver filtering, grid/raster classification or sampling. Orientation of a simple orthogonal cycle uses integer total quarter-turn +/-4, equivalent to signed shoelace orientation without floating overflow/underflow. Non-simple/ambiguous walk refuses rather than claiming approximation.
work_cancel: WorkMeter.step before each validation unit, pair/cut test or insertion, sort comparison/move, original winding crossing, boundary/vertex lookup, endpoint-neighbor hop, contour reference, normalization comparison/move, west scan, parent assignment and canonical permutation. WorkMeter record methods preserve admitted event/intersection counts on error; final check precedes return. All caller inputs immutable.
